The waveform assignments are correct. v1 is the transformer-coupled high-frequency carrier, (c). v2 is the low-frequency signal wave in series with bias supply E1, (a). v3 is the tuned-tank output, the AM wave (b). The circuit applies the signal wave to the base, so (ア) is ベース and this is a base modulation circuit.
